Category: Object.
Subject: 1980s arcade cabinet.

spec.name: Neon Cabinet 1984
spec.description: A synthwave 1980s upright arcade cabinet with a glowing magenta and cyan marquee, angled screen, joystick control panel, and neon side art.
spec.layout: Classic upright cabinet. A tapered side-profile body stands on the floor with a recessed kick plate. The front (+Z) has a slanted control panel at about y 0.95 that juts forward, a vertical coin door below it, and a bezel with a screen leaning slightly back above it. A marquee box tops the cabinet and overhangs the front a little. The body is dark indigo-black, with hot magenta and cyan neon stripes, a sunset-gradient side decal built from stacked small plates, a grid and palm motif, and chrome trim. Screen, marquee, buttons and coin slot glow. No ground or extra props.

parts.builds: Main cabinet body: two extruded side panels with the classic stepped profile (tall back, forward-leaning control shelf, notched kick base) in body colour, back panel, front lower panel, top cap, kick plate in kick colour, chrome T-molding strips along the side edges, small feet. Cyan and magenta neon edge strips along the front edges. Overall stays inside its box and rests on the floor.
parts.attaches: Top meets marquee at marqueeBase; front meets the control panel at panelFront and the coin door at coinDoor; sides carry the decal at sideLeft/sideRight.

parts.builds: Slanted control deck jutting forward: sloped purple-black top plate with chrome front lip, a joystick (dark base, chrome shaft, red ball top), six glowing round buttons in red, blue and yellow with dark rims, two coin-style player-start buttons, small neon cyan outline trace and printed-style label stripes as thin parts. Includes the lower coin door: dark plate with two glowing slots, return cups, small chrome plates, and a pink neon frame.
parts.attaches: Rests against the carcass front at panelFront and coinDoor.

parts.builds: Screen area: bezel box frame in black with a recessed tilted CRT glass, glow-green screen face with a small pixel-art scene as parts (alien invaders rows, a ship, score text bars in cyan and magenta), chrome corner bolts, a cyan neon frame inside the bezel, speaker grille slits below the marquee as thin dark bars.
parts.attaches: Sits on the control deck rear edge at screenCentre and is bounded above by the marquee at marqueeBase.

parts.builds: Top marquee box with a slightly overhanging front: dark housing, glowing backlit front sign in magenta with a cyan outline, a stacked striped sun (yellow, orange, pink bands) with a perspective grid and a pair of palm silhouettes as small parts, a chrome top trim, lit LED dots along the bottom edge, and the cabinet name as blocky letter bars.
parts.attaches: Rests on the carcass top at marqueeBase.

parts.builds: Synthwave decals on both side panels, mirrored, built as thin plates seated 4 mm off the sides: a big sunset sun made of horizontal bands in yellow to pink, a purple mountain silhouette, a magenta and cyan perspective grid of lines at the bottom, and diagonal neon stripes with a small star field of white dots. Also a rear back-panel vent grille and an AC power plate with a cord.
parts.attaches: Plates sit on sideLeft and sideRight surfaces of the carcass; the back items on its rear face.
